The page assigns projections, with -Π_{U_a} at the X_a sources. It shows Π_V-Π_U has rank dim V-dim U (identity on V∩U^⊥, zero on U⊥V^⊥), identifies the N exceptional edges 2Π_{U_a} of rank one, checks the endpoint differences equal Id, and gets s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m, citing the paper's numerical value.
The construction is given in full: 'A vertex labelled U gets the projection Π_U onto U along U^⊥, except sources: −Π_{U_a} at X_a, else 0.'
'Endpoint differences (Π_{U_a^⊥}+Π_{U_a} from source X_a to sink Y_a, else Id−0) all equal Id'. The routing X_a→Y_a is implicit rather than named as ρ, but the identity is checked on every role.
's_b=(W_b m−2N+2L_b)+N=W_b m−(N−2L_b)'. This combines the absolute dimension sum with the N extra rank-one source edges.
The numerical value 177176569088785861287000000 appears only inside the cited paper passage. It is not computed on the page, though it is correct.

'For U⊂V, Π_V−Π_U (identity on V∩U^⊥, zero on U⊥V^⊥) has rank dim V−dim U, as does its negative.' Nondegeneracy of the labels, which the paper names here, is implicit in the page's definition of Π_U along U^⊥.
'Only X_a's first edge differs'. Every other vertex carries Π of its label, the zero sources having label 0, so the N exceptions are exactly the X_a source edges.
'at stage 1 its first gate has label U_a, so 2Π_{U_a} has rank one where the dimension change is zero'. The page established B=0 at stage 1 earlier.
'The deficit W_b m−s_b=N−2L_b=339/539 N is positive because L_b/N<1/2'. The arithmetic is correct.
For X_a the page gives Π_{U_a^⊥}+Π_{U_a}=Id; for all other roles it gives 'Id−0'. This matches the paper.
The page states only the result s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m, with a link to Binary phase frames. The assignment places this derivation on that page.

errors.quote: nested along every edge, whose dimension changes count each edge's *smaller calls*
errors.problem: In the bit network the smaller calls are counted by the rational rank of the matrix differences, not by the dimension changes. On the N first edges of the X_a wires the dimension change is zero but the rank is one, so s_b exceeds the sum of absolute dimension changes by N. The page itself corrects this later ('s_b=(W_b m-2N+2L_b)+N'); the paper counts calls as the rank of the edge differences.
